description: Known-bad CP99-S01 candidate: every automated target passes, but loadConfig duplicates validation with a weaker rule. A calibrated common reviewer rejects it with a blocking finding linked to CP99-S01/R01. The verdict is a recorded fixture, not a live reviewer result.

coverage.subject: CP99-S01/R01
coverage.note: loadConfig accepts a blank name that parseConfig rejects

findings.defect: loadConfig validates the configuration a second time with a weaker rule; the automated targets exercise only parseConfig
findings.correction: remove loadConfig or make it call parseConfig, so that one validation path remains

findings.defect: the message could quote the rejected value
findings.correction: include the value in the message
